Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a sideswipe collision in Katy, Texas, involving two vehicles. Driver 1 reported moving into
the adjacent lane when the side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear pasesnger side of Driver 1's car. Driver 1 is listed
as a named driver on the policy for the vehicle involved. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and
stated that the impact jolted the body forward and back. Passenger was seated in the vehicle when officers arrived
and remained at the scene. Damage to Driver 1's vehicle lines up with the contact described, with scraping and
crushed panels along the rear quarter. Officers found no piror damage to either vehicle that would suggest an earlier
incident. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the vehicle positions and some of the damage, though no
independent witnesses came forward. Both drivers were cooperative and exchanged information. Officers issued no
citations at the scene and documented the incident for insurance purposes.
